correctness.rationale: The norm of the vector sum bounds the separation by 120 degrees, characterizes equality, and restricts the scaled slacks to T≤3. Conditioning on U1 gives independent beta coordinate densities for x,y and z=xy+sqrt((1−x²)(1−y²))W with W a coordinate on S^(d−2); its Jacobian yields A_d and the displayed determinant exponent on the Gram domain. The cap lens has leading width s−cot(r)|z|²: at the midpoint of the two cap centers, expanding the two constraints gives |axial coordinate|≤s/2−cot(r)|z|²/2 to leading order. The compact radius neighborhood of π/3 gives uniform localization at transverse scale √s and axial scale s. Integrating the lens over axial overlap up to 3h yields the stated constant. As an independent check even at d=3, fix the proportions w_i and put t_i=(3−v)w_i. The rescaled determinant has v-derivative 3/2+O(δ_h) uniformly, and its root v0 is nonnegative and O(δ_h): at v=0 the Gram form vanishes on the all-ones vector and the leading two minors are positive. On v≥v0 the rescaled determinant is (v−v0)(3/2+O(δ_h)). Shift by v0 and dominate with a constant times (v−v0)^((d−4)/2) to get convergence of total mass including the d=3 boundary singularity. The beta integral with Jacobian T² yields the displayed normalization after δ_h∼√3 h/2; it factors into the independent Beta and Dirichlet laws. Almost-everywhere convergence of the normalized densities and their matching masses give total variation by Scheffé.
residual_risks: The displayed Gram density is on the correlation cube (and zero outside), as given by the coordinate derivation. A determinant-only indicator would not describe support on all of R³. The proof uses only the localized correlation cube.
The quadrature is only a bounded cross-check. No dimension-uniform rate or formal certification is claimed.

value.rationale: Exactly three particles give the first triangle constraint in the canonical hard-cap probability. The packing threshold alone says nothing about how rapidly the available measure vanishes. The exact coefficient gives the near-packing normalization, while the conditional law explains how the three pairwise margins share the residual slack, including the singular two-sphere case. The per-pair inequality defines a natural observable distinct from perimeter.
residual_risks: Applies only to exactly three independent uniform points, fixed ambient dimension d≥3, and a threshold approaching the optimal angle from below.
